hints.title: Monotonic Matrix Properties
hints.text: Rows and columns are both sorted in ascending order. The smallest element is at top-left and the largest is at bottom-right.

hints.title: Range Bisection and Counting
hints.text: Apply value-range bisection between matrix minimum and maximum. Count how many elements are less than or equal to mid in linear time.

hints.title: Linear Saddleback Counting
hints.text: Start at bottom-left corner row N minus 1 and col 0. If current value is at most mid, then all elements above it in the current column are also at most mid: add row plus 1 to count and move right. Otherwise move up.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: side length of square matrix
MAX - MIN: range of values in matrix
complexity.notes: Value range bisection with O(N) staircase count per iteration.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Flattening and sorting the whole matrix takes O(N^2 * log(N^2)) time and O(N^2) space.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary search on values uses O(1) auxiliary space without copying elements.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use staircase counting from bottom-left to count elements in O(N) time per probe.
